title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #8

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How many verses are in Surah Al-Ikhlas? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 3

2. Which surah says "Say: He is Allah, the One"? (1 mark)
   A. An-Naas
   B. Al-Ikhlas
   C. Al-Masad
   D. Al-Kafirun

3. The two surahs of seeking refuge are (1 mark)
   A. Al-Kafirun and Al-Fatiha
   B. Al-Masad and An-Nasr
   C. Al-Fatiha and Al-Ikhlas
   D. Al-Falaq and An-Naas

4. Zawadi prays on time but shouts at her brother. What is wrong? (1 mark)
   A. Good prayer should go with good manners
   B. Prayer is wrong
   C. Shouting is a Sunnah
   D. Nothing is wrong

5. Who narrated the eating hadith from the syllabus? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Bukhari
   B. Ibn Majah
   C. Al-Hakim
   D. Abu Lahab

6. What is a benefit of saying Bismillah? (1 mark)
   A. It makes food free
   B. It stops hunger forever
   C. It cooks the food
   D. It brings blessing to the food

7. How much toothpaste should a child use? (1 mark)
   A. A full tube
   B. A whole handful
   C. None
   D. A pea-sized amount

8. Which name of Allah is in every "Bismillah" along with Ar-Rahim? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Basir
   B. Ar-Rahman
   C. Al-Malik
   D. As-Salam

9. Which verse teaches that nothing is like Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 112:1
   B. Qur'an 1:1
   C. Qur'an 42:11
   D. Qur'an 110:1

10. Rain that falls on farms of everyone is a sign of which name? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Basir
   B. As-Salam
   C. Ar-Rahman
   D. As-Sami'

11. The greeting "As-salamu alaykum" is a prayer for (1 mark)
   A. Rain
   B. Peace
   C. Food
   D. Money

12. Which prophet's story shows a person who refused wrongdoing and feared Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Nuh
   B. Hud
   C. Ilyas
   D. Yusuf

13. What is the difference between a nabi and a rasul? (1 mark)
   A. They are the same in every way
   B. A nabi is an angel
   C. A rasul is a prophet given a message or book to deliver
   D. A rasul is a jinn

14. Which of these is a najasa? (1 mark)
   A. Sweat
   B. Milk
   C. Clean water
   D. Urine

15. Which of these is NOT a najasa? (1 mark)
   A. Stool
   B. Blood that flows
   C. Vomit
   D. Human sweat

16. What does "twahara" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Fasting
   B. Purity
   C. Prayer
   D. Charity

17. Which item may be used together with water in washing a heavy najasa? (1 mark)
   A. Sugar
   B. Salt
   C. Clean soil
   D. Paint

18. Kamal made wudhu at 6 a.m. and only ate lunch. Is wudhu still valid? (1 mark)
   A. Yes
   B. Only if he sleeps
   C. Only if he rinses
   D. No

19. Before which of these is wudhu required? (1 mark)
   A. Playing
   B. Prayer
   C. Eating
   D. Sleeping only

20. Which health benefit does wudhu give? (1 mark)
   A. It makes us thirsty
   B. It causes sleep
   C. It stops hunger
   D. It removes germs from exposed body parts

21. How many rak'ahs does Dhuhr have? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Four
   C. Three
   D. Two

22. Which prayer is right after sunset? (1 mark)
   A. Fajr
   B. Maghrib
   C. Asr
   D. Dhuhr

23. What is a pillar (rukn) of swalah? (1 mark)
   A. A place
   B. A part that must be done for the prayer to be valid
   C. A drink
   D. A type of clothing

24. How many sujud are in each rak'ah? (1 mark)
   A. One
   B. Four
   C. Two
   D. Three

25. What is sujud? (1 mark)
   A. Bowing
   B. Standing
   C. Prostration
   D. Greeting

26. What did the Prophet tell the man who prayed in a hurry? (1 mark)
   A. Go back and pray again
   B. Continue
   C. Ignore it
   D. Pray faster

27. Which of these should be avoided? (1 mark)
   A. Clean clothes
   B. Neat school uniform
   C. Shoes
   D. Boys dressing to look like girls

28. What does Qur'an 49:6 tell us about news? (1 mark)
   A. Check it first
   B. Share it quickly
   C. Change it
   D. Ignore it

29. Which of these shows tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring safety
   B. Doing nothing and hoping
   C. Blaming luck
   D. Taking an umbrella and trusting Allah

30. What does "tawakkaltu 'alallah" mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am tired
   B. I am happy
   C. I depend on Allah
   D. I am hungry

31. Which of these is a manner of dua? (1 mark)
   A. Ask with humility and hope
   B. Give up quickly
   C. Demand
   D. Shout

32. Who deserves the best company according to the hadith, asked three times? (1 mark)
   A. Your mother
   B. Your teacher
   C. Your friend
   D. Your neighbour

33. What can children do for parents who have died? (1 mark)
   A. Sell their things
   B. Make dua for them
   C. Forget them
   D. Complain

34. Which is honest behaviour toward parents? (1 mark)
   A. Hiding
   B. Telling the truth and not hiding things
   C. Blaming others
   D. Lying

35. What should we do when a grandparent repeats stories? (1 mark)
   A. Shout
   B. Leave
   C. Laugh at them
   D. Listen patiently

36. Which surah contains the first five verses revealed? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Alaq
   B. Al-Ikhlas
   C. Al-Fatiha
   D. An-Nasr

37. What did Khadija do when the Prophet returned frightened? (1 mark)
   A. Comforted and covered him
   B. Ignored him
   C. Left
   D. Blamed him

38. How did Khadija support the Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. With comfort and her wealth
   B. By harming him
   C. By leaving him
   D. By ignoring him

39. Who was the first Caliph? (1 mark)
   A. Ali
   B. Abu Bakr
   C. Umar
   D. Uthman

40. Who was the first person to believe in the Prophet's message? (1 mark)
   A. Abu Bakr
   B. Bilal
   C. Khadija
   D. Ali

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Explain the hadith in which the mother is mentioned three times before the father. (3 marks)

42. Explain the meaning of the hadith "I have been sent for the purpose of perfecting good morals". (3 marks)

43. State three values learned from participating in sports. (3 marks)

44. What is a pillar of swalah? (2 marks)

45. In a group role-play, a child finds Ksh 50 in the school field. Explain what a person of the Prophet's character would do and why. (5 marks)

46. Why is Laylat al-Qadr connected to the first revelation? (3 marks)

47. State three times when the siwak or toothbrush is recommended. (3 marks)

48. Explain tuma'ninah and give the story that shows its importance. (3 marks)

49. Plan a Muslim school sports day including at least five rules or activities. (5 marks)

50. What warning did the Prophet give about cutting family ties? (3 marks)

51. Name the five daily prayers in order and give the rak'ahs of any two. (3 marks)

52. What should a child do when two cousins quarrel? (3 marks)

53. State three virtues the Prophet showed in Taif. (3 marks)

54. State three evils of begging. (3 marks)

55. Explain why we should behave well even when nobody is watching. (2 marks)

56. Explain what Qur'an 17:23-24 teaches about treating parents. (3 marks)

57. State three times when it is recommended to be in wudhu. (3 marks)

58. State three benefits of saying the duas for leaving and entering the house. (3 marks)

59. State the dua for parents and its meaning. (2 marks)

60. State two ways to know the times of prayer. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — 4
   Al-Ikhlas has four verses.

2. B — Al-Ikhlas
   These are the first words of Al-Ikhlas.

3. D — Al-Falaq and An-Naas
   Both begin with "Qul a'udhu", meaning "Say: I seek refuge".

4. A — Good prayer should go with good manners
   The Prophet was sent to perfect good morals as well.

5. A — Al-Bukhari
   The syllabus gives Al-Bukhari.

6. D — It brings blessing to the food
   We ask Allah to bless it.

7. D — A pea-sized amount
   A small amount is enough.

8. B — Ar-Rahman
   Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Rahim contains both names.

9. C — Qur'an 42:11
   It says there is nothing like Him and He is the All-Hearing, All-Seeing.

10. C — Ar-Rahman
   Allah's mercy covers all creatures.

11. B — Peace
   It means "peace be upon you".

12. D — Yusuf
   Yusuf refused temptation.

13. C — A rasul is a prophet given a message or book to deliver
   A messenger delivers a specific message.

14. D — Urine
   Urine must be washed off before prayer.

15. D — Human sweat
   Sweat is pure.

16. B — Purity
   Twahara is the Arabic word for purity.

17. C — Clean soil
   One of the washings uses soil.

18. A — Yes
   Eating does not break wudhu.

19. B — Prayer
   Prayer needs wudhu.

20. D — It removes germs from exposed body parts
   Washing keeps us clean.

21. B — Four
   Dhuhr has four.

22. B — Maghrib
   Maghrib is after sunset.

23. B — A part that must be done for the prayer to be valid
   Leaving a pillar spoils the prayer.

24. C — Two
   Each rak'ah has two sujud.

25. C — Prostration
   Forehead on the ground.

26. A — Go back and pray again
   He did not pray properly.

27. D — Boys dressing to look like girls
   Islam asks each to dress appropriately.

28. A — Check it first
   Verify before acting.

29. D — Taking an umbrella and trusting Allah
   Do your part and trust Allah.

30. C — I depend on Allah
   Tawakkul is trust in Allah.

31. A — Ask with humility and hope
   Dua is humble.

32. A — Your mother
   Then the father on the fourth time.

33. B — Make dua for them
   A righteous child's dua benefits them.

34. B — Telling the truth and not hiding things
   Honesty.

35. D — Listen patiently
   Patience with the old.

36. A — Al-Alaq
   Surah 96.

37. A — Comforted and covered him
   She reassured him.

38. A — With comfort and her wealth
   She supported him fully.

39. B — Abu Bakr
   Abu Bakr led the Muslims after the Prophet.

40. C — Khadija
   Khadija was first.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: The mother deserves the best company because of her great hardship in carrying and raising the child. But the father must also be honoured.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for the reason, 1 mark for honouring both.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: The Prophet's mission included completing and perfecting good character. Good manners are part of the faith and must be practised every day.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for perfecting good morals, 1 mark for part of faith, 1 mark for daily practice.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Teamwork, sharing, humility, fair play, discipline, leadership.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each value.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: A part of the prayer which must be done for it to be valid.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for part and 1 mark for validity.

45. (5 marks)
   Answer: Hand it to the teacher so the owner can be found. Honesty and trustworthiness. It is not ours, and Allah sees everything.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the action, 1 mark for honesty, 1 mark for trust, 1 mark for the reason, 1 mark for a clear explanation.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: The Qur'an says it was sent down on the Night of Power in Ramadan, which is why Ramadan is special.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the Night of Power, 1 mark for Ramadan, 1 mark for the Qur'an.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Before wudhu and prayer, on waking up, when the mouth smells, before sleeping.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct time.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tuma'ninah is staying still and calm in each position. The Prophet told a man who prayed hurriedly to go back and pray again.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for the story, 1 mark for the lesson.

49. (5 marks)
   Answer: Bismillah at the start, modest kits, fair play, warm-up, stop for prayer, respect referees, greet teams, thank Allah at the end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid rule or activity, up to 5.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: The one who cuts family ties will not enter Paradise. So we should keep ties strong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the warning, 1 mark for the meaning, 1 mark for the lesson.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: Fajr (2), Dhuhr (4), Asr (4), Maghrib (3), Isha (4). Any two with correct rak'ahs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for names in order and 2 marks for two rak'ahs.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stay calm, encourage them to forgive and make peace, and ask an elder if needed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for calm, 1 mark for peace, 1 mark for asking elders.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: Patience, tolerance, perseverance, mercy, trust in Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: Loss of dignity, laziness, wasted resources, lies, harm to children.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: Allah is Al-Basir and sees everything, and As-Sami' hears everything.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Allah sees and hears and 1 mark for good behaviour.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: Do not say "uff", speak kindly, be humble and make dua for them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of three teachings.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: Before prayer, before touching the Qur'an, before sleeping, before reciting Qur'an.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: Protection, remembering Allah, blessings and peace, following the Sunnah, building good habits.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira: My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for words and 1 mark for meaning.

60. (2 marks)
   Answer: Adhan, printed mosque timetable, prayer app, watching the sun.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
